description:
Welcome to the weirdest NBA channel on YouTube. If you love basketball, follow the NBA, and strongly dislike Richard Jefferson, congratulations, you’re home.

This channel is a chaotic collection of one-of-a-kind interviews with NBA legends, basketball comedy, podcasts, shorts, and random videos that somehow made it from my brain to a camera and now directly into your algorithm.

If you love it… amazing.
If you don’t… that sounds like a you problem. What am I, your therapist??

Shows & content you’ll find here: ⬇️
-- The Richard Show (yes, me, Rizzard)
-- Road Trippin’ (NBA stories, BTS basket
